name: ishii-restaurant
reviewNotes: All 46 original glyph records reviewed: dining, crystal hints, fish purchasing, Ginji and his family, and restaurant patrons.
Use established 志井料亭, 新月水晶, 比隆, 露肚怪, 雪人, 寢太郎村 and 阿濱. 證城寺 remains the existing provisional rendering of しょじょ寺; 阿與 for the father's kana name よー is provisional pending further source evidence.

Retain all five fish-count branches, both declined-sale responses, dynamic item and quantity fields, the dining pause and all original newlines. Fish-count labels omit decorative punctuation to fit an eight-cell item plus a five-digit quantity.
The pufferfish diner chokes from eating too quickly, not from poisoning. No meal, purchase or recruitment mechanics are changed.
